purpose: Teach: コム/ヲタ/お稽古/絢爛/斬る/食い物/大海/面子

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがドットコム、つまりコムの登録を早くされた
lines.en: You know, when your father was young, he registered a dotcom domain name early on.
lines.style: Nostalgic, conversational opening. Soft reminiscent tone. Paces gently, like drawing up a memory. Looks toward Sachiko with quiet affection, inviting her into the recollection.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、ご自身を「カメラのヲタ」って笑ってらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: That's right — and your grandfather used to laugh about himself, calling himself a camera enthusiast, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warm, slightly teasing undertone. Affirming and gently correcting the direction. A knowing smile in the voice. Leans into the shared memory with gentle humor.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが書道のお稽古に通われた
lines.en: When your father was younger, he attended calligraphy lessons regularly.
lines.style: Same wistful patience as before. Slight pause after opening, gathering the next memory. Soft delivery, as if handling something precious. Measured pacing.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、絢爛豪華なお祭りに見入られたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather was fascinated by the splendor of those festivals, wasn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warm, slightly animated — the memory of beauty brings a little brightness. Tender underneath. Small pause on the image, savoring it. Genuine affection in 'dear'.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが時代劇の悪を斬る場面に惹かれた
lines.en: When your father was young, he was drawn to the scenes in period dramas where the villain gets cut down.
lines.style: Wistful but with a hint of understanding amusement. The vulnerability of young desire held gently. Steady pace. Voice doesn't judge — just observes and remembers.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、夜食の食い物を作って下さったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather used to make late-night snacks for us when he was young, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warm, appreciative, with a soft smile underneath. Touches on tenderness — the care embedded in that small act. Gentle rising at 'didn't he' — inviting agreement, not testing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは「大海を知らずに帰るな」と言われた
lines.en: When your father was young, he was told, "Don't come home without knowing the vastness of the world."
lines.style: Reverential, quiet. These words land with weight — a teaching, almost sacred. Slight elongation on the phrase itself, honoring what was said. Wistful but steady.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、麻雀の面子を揃えるのが上手だったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather had a gift for bringing together the right people for mahjong, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warm, affectionate, with gentle closure. A soft smile resting in the voice. Tender fadeout on 'dear' — the conversation naturally settling. Small, satisfied tone.
